annotations.title: Generate DoD Other Transaction Authority (OTA / 10 U.S.C. 4022) Prototype White Paper & Milestone Schedule

description: Convert commercial dual-use technology specifications and DoD Problem Statements / Commercial Solutions Openings (CSOs) / Request for Prototype Proposals (RPPs) across DIU, C5ISR/CECOM, SOSSEC, SpEC, MTEC, NSTXL, and AFWERX into a 10 U.S.C. 4022 statutory eligibility assessment, evaluator-ready OTA Prototype White Paper sections, an outcome-based Fixed-Price Payable Milestone Schedule & Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM), a Phase 3 Sole-Source Follow-On Production Strategy under 10 U.S.C. 4022(f), an OTA Intellectual Property & Data Rights posture (FAR/DFARS/Bayh-Dole exempt), and consortium pitch deck talking points. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive capture and prototype proposal generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `commercial_solution_and_problem_topic_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `target_ota_consortium_and_pathway` and `nontraditional_contractor_and_cost_share_status` calibrate consortium formatting and 10 U.S.C. 4022(d)(1) Nontraditional Defense Contractor [NDC], Small Business, or 1/3 cost-share rules). Use this tool when drafting a DoD 10 U.S.C. 4022 Other Transaction Authority (OTA) Prototype White Paper, DIU Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) solution brief, or Fixed-Price Payable Milestone Schedule; use `generate_sbir_sttr_commercialization` instead for 15 U.S.C. 638 SBIR/STTR Phase I-III proposals, or `generate_rfp_response` for traditional FAR Part 15 technical proposal volumes.

commercial_solution_and_problem_topic_te.description: DoD Problem Statement / CSO / RPP topic description (DIU, C5ISR/CECOM, SOSSEC, SpEC, MTEC, NSTXL) and vendor's dual-use commercial technology, TRL, and architecture (20 to 45,000 characters).

nontraditional_contractor_and_cost_share.description: 10 U.S.C. 4022 statutory eligibility posture: Nontraditional Defense Contractor (NDC), Small Business, or Traditional Defense Contractor with NDC sub / 1/3 cost-share (defaults to 'Nontraditional_Defense_Contractor_NDC_Zero_Cost_Share').

target_ota_consortium_and_pathway.description: Target OTA pathway or consortium (e.g., DIU Commercial Solutions Opening [CSO], SOSSEC, SpEC Space Enterprise Consortium, C5ISR, NSTXL, AFWERX; defaults to 'DIU_Commercial_Solutions_Opening_CSO').

name: generate_ota_white_paper

consortium_pitch_deck_talking_points.description: High-impact talking points for the Phase 2 DIU / Consortium oral pitch and live technical demonstration.

dual_use_and_follow_on_production_strate.description: TRL advancement roadmap, commercial dual-use viability, and 10 U.S.C. 4022(f) non-competitive follow-on production transition strategy.

executive_white_paper_sections.description: Evaluator-ready OTA Prototype White Paper / Solution Brief sections tailored to DIU CSO and DoD Consortium scoring criteria.

intellectual_property_and_data_rights_po.description: OTA Intellectual Property and Data Rights negotiation posture leveraging FAR/DFARS/Bayh-Dole exemptions.

ota_statutory_eligibility_assessment.description: 10 U.S.C. 4022 statutory eligibility assessment covering NDC/Small Business status, cost-share exemption, and 10 U.S.C. 4022(f) sole-source production eligibility.

payable_milestone_schedule_and_rom.description: Outcome-based Fixed-Price Payable Milestone Schedule and Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) pricing table.

title: Generate DoD Other Transaction Authority (OTA / 10 U.S.C. 4022) Prototype White Paper & Milestone Schedule
